definition.label: Articular cartilage lesion
supporting_findings: Effusion and motion findings are assessment domains
assessment_requirements: Record lesion location and structural classification only from a documented assessment
Record symptom and function measures separately
diagnostic_criteria: ICRS evaluation is structural context, not a diagnosis inferred from symptoms
limitations: Symptoms overlap other knee disorders; no sensitivity or specificity supplied.

definition.label: Infection or another urgent cause: physician review
assessment_requirements: Use existing governed Clinical Safety Rule Engine and physician assessment
Do not interpret lack of fever or lack of a rule alert as safety clearance
warning_features: Inflamed joint with or without fever
diagnostic_criteria: No clinical finding alone confirms or excludes joint infection
limitations: Outside elective knee differential review; no definitive infectious diagnosis.

definition.label: Knee osteoarthritis
supporting_findings: OA-compatible symptom pattern for clinician review
assessment_requirements: Document pain and function separately from radiographic grade
warning_features: Painful inflamed joint with or without fever
diagnostic_criteria: No formal criteria automatically applied in this pack
limitations: Presentation is nonspecific; no confirmed diagnosis or probability.

definition.label: Meniscal disorder: distinguish acute and degenerative
supporting_findings: Joint-line tenderness or meniscal maneuver findings require contextual interpretation
assessment_requirements: Establish onset, mechanism and true movement restriction
Distinguish degenerative from acute isolated pathology
warning_features: Acute displaced lesion with movement restriction warrants specialist assessment
limitations: AAOS acute guideline and ESCAPE trial have distinct populations.
Concomitant ligament injury is an applicability limit of isolated acute guidance, not evidence against a coexisting meniscal lesion.

definition.label: Osteochondral disorder / knee OCD review
assessment_requirements: Establish radiographic lesion context, maturity and stability
Clinician considers MRI for known knee OCD or concomitant pathology
warning_features: Symptomatic unstable or displaced lesion requires specialist assessment
diagnostic_criteria: No structural diagnosis inferred from pain or an unconfirmed imaging report
limitations: AAOS OCD scope is narrower than all osteochondral disorders.

evidence_references.statement: The ACS 2024 review abstract reports heterogeneous, conflicting comparisons and insufficient support; six-month saline comparisons did not establish pain/function benefit.
evidence_references.population: People with knee OA in the cited source populations; product and trial eligibility require review.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Only indexed abstract checked; full-text extraction and independent certainty assessment remain incomplete.

evidence_references.statement: ICRS describes cartilage lesion structure and location while recording symptoms/function separately; structural grade must not be inferred from pain.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Evaluation instrument rather than diagnostic-accuracy evidence; copyrighted classification forms are not reproduced.

evidence_references.statement: ICRS assessment documents onset, injury, swelling, mechanical symptoms, function, prior surgery, effusion and motion.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Assessment domains are not criteria proving a cartilage lesion; no test accuracy is inferred.

evidence_references.statement: With the patient supine, locate medial/lateral joint lines by palpation during slow flexion/extension and record the site of tenderness.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Educational method, not a diagnostic-accuracy study; distinguish adjacent bursal tenderness and do not infer meniscal diagnosis.

evidence_references.statement: Assess active motion before passive motion; record restriction and pain and compare sides.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Clinician-performed assessment; this is not a stand-alone diagnostic criterion or a complete acute-injury examination protocol.

evidence_references.statement: ESCAPE found exercise-based physical therapy noninferior to partial meniscectomy for five-year knee function in its enrolled degenerative-tear population.
evidence_references.population: Trial participants aged 45-70 with degenerative meniscal tears.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Locked knees and baseline KL4 excluded; crossover and noninferiority design limit extrapolation to acute displaced tears.

evidence_references.statement: Joint-line tenderness and meniscal maneuvers can inform assessment, with diagnostic accuracy varying among tests and studies.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: No universal sensitivity, specificity or definitive diagnosis is assigned to a maneuver.

evidence_references.statement: AAOS 2024 consensus highlights displaced acute tears restricting movement as potential candidates for acute specialist surgical assessment.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Consensus option with Very Low evidence quality; reported locking alone does not confirm a displaced tear.

evidence_references.statement: AAOS 2024 identifies MRI as the preferred modality for suspected acute meniscal tears (Strong recommendation; High evidence quality).
evidence_references.population: Patients with suspected acute isolated meniscal pathology.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: No automatic imaging order or interpretation; this scope does not include all chronic knee pain.

evidence_references.statement: The AAOS 2024 acute isolated meniscal guideline excludes degenerative tears and associated ligament injury; onset and mechanism determine applicability.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Draft paraphrase; independent specialist appraisal and current-source review are required.

evidence_references.statement: ACR/AF 2019 strongly supports exercise for knee OA, with activity choice informed by preferences, access and individual circumstances.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Recommendation strength is not individual response prediction; no exercise dose or automatic program is specified.

evidence_references.statement: AAOS 2021 advises against routine hyaluronic acid injection use for symptomatic knee OA, with Moderate recommendation strength.
evidence_references.population: People with knee OA in the cited source populations; product and trial eligibility require review.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Guideline position is separate from product authorization; no regulatory conclusion or patient-specific treatment decision is inferred.

evidence_references.statement: Kellgren-Lawrence grades radiographic OA; record pain and function separately despite associations between radiographic severity and pain.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: No deterministic symptom, disability or treatment mapping from KL grade; image interpretation belongs to the imaging workflow.

evidence_references.statement: OA may involve pain, stiffness, swelling and reduced function; these findings individually do not establish a diagnosis.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Draft paraphrase; independent specialist appraisal and current-source review are required.

evidence_references.statement: AAOS 2021 describes possible PRP pain/function benefit in symptomatic knee OA, with Limited recommendation strength.
evidence_references.population: People with knee OA in the cited source populations; product and trial eligibility require review.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Preparation variation and evidence limitations apply; this is not an individual recommendation or proof of cartilage regeneration.

evidence_references.statement: ACR/AF 2019 strongly recommends against PRP for knee/hip OA, citing preparation and technique heterogeneity.
evidence_references.population: People with knee OA in the cited source populations; product and trial eligibility require review.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: This differs from the AAOS 2021 position; both source editions remain visible without choosing a preferred recommendation.

evidence_references.statement: ACR/AF 2019 strongly supports topical NSAIDs for knee OA; medication risks and comorbidities require assessment.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: No prescribing, dose or comprehensive contraindication list is supplied.

evidence_references.statement: For knee OA with overweight or obesity, ACR/AF 2019 strongly supports weight loss.
evidence_references.population: People with knee OA and overweight or obesity.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: No automatic weight target or protocol is inferred; suitability and goals require clinician assessment.

evidence_references.statement: For persistent symptoms after OCD treatment, AAOS consensus supports considering repeat history, examination and radiographs and/or MRI for healing assessment.
evidence_references.population: Skeletally immature or mature patients with knee osteochondritis dissecans, according to the cited recommendation.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Consensus is distinct from high-quality comparative treatment evidence; no follow-up interval is prescribed.

evidence_references.statement: AAOS 2023 supports considering MRI to characterize a known knee OCD lesion on radiographs or suspected concomitant pathology (High recommendation strength).
evidence_references.population: Skeletally immature or mature patients with knee osteochondritis dissecans, according to the cited recommendation.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Specific to knee OCD, not every knee pain presentation or cartilage abnormality.

evidence_references.statement: For symptomatic unstable/displaced knee OCD, AAOS 2023 offers surgery as an option in immature and mature patients (Limited strength).
evidence_references.population: Skeletally immature or mature patients with knee osteochondritis dissecans, according to the cited recommendation.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Symptoms, maturity and stability require specialist review; no procedure is chosen automatically.

evidence_references.statement: The 2024 platelet lysate review abstract describes sparse clinical literature and calls for larger comparative studies.
evidence_references.population: People with knee OA in the cited source populations; product and trial eligibility require review.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Abstract only; optimistic review language is not established safety or efficacy, and no numeric effect is extracted.

evidence_references.statement: A 2017 PRGF trial compared one preparation with HA for six months; between-group pain/function differences were not statistically significant.
evidence_references.population: Trial participants aged 50-70 with mild-to-moderate knee OA (KL II-III).
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Single-blinding, limited sample and no saline arm; nonsignificance does not establish equivalence or efficacy over placebo.
Do not generalize this preparation to all PRGF/PRP products or infer cartilage regeneration.

evidence_references.statement: The FDA 2020 notice states that its listed stem-cell, exosome and adipose-derived/SVF products lacked orthopedic-condition approval.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Historical United States notice; current product-specific authorization in Iran or any jurisdiction requires separate verification.
Regulatory material does not establish efficacy or universal legal status in 2026.

evidence_references.statement: SANJO advises suspicion with a painful inflamed joint, with or without fever; clinical findings alone cannot confirm or exclude infection.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Draft knowledge for physician review only; no new operational safety-engine rule is activated.

evidence_references.statement: After acute limb trauma, circulatory or neurological abnormality requires prompt clinician neurovascular assessment; suspected arterial injury needs emergency specialist review.
evidence_references.population: People with acute musculoskeletal limb trauma.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: Professional standard; no definitive vascular diagnosis or new operational safety rule is created.

evidence_references.statement: SANJO identifies concomitant sepsis or shock as requiring immediate clinical attention.
application_conditions: Clinician review of the stated source population and context is required.
limitations: No definitive diagnosis is emitted by this knowledge pack; existing governed Safety Rule Engine remains authoritative.
